# Fable (FABL)

> Fable is a share sale on BNB Smart Chain. 3,000 shares of 1,000,000 FABL each, cut from a fixed supply of 3,000,000,000. 300 shares are free (one per wallet), 2,700 are sold at 0.002 BNB each to anyone, with no per-wallet limit. Sale window: 2026-11-17 00:30 WIB to 2026-11-24 00:30 WIB.

Site: https://fable-fabl.github.io/fable/
Contract: 0x182bcB5c1E1611db8c83eDe75C7E518eACEad2A2
Agent instructions: https://fable-fabl.github.io/fable/agent.md
Skill: https://fable-fabl.github.io/fable/skill.md

## Key facts

- Chain: BNB Smart Chain (56)
- Token: Fable (FABL), 18 decimals, supply 3,000,000,000, immutable contract, no admin
- 1 share = 1,000,000 FABL
- Free claim: claimFree(), 300 shares total, 1 per wallet, no conditions of any kind
- Buy: buy(n) with exactly n * 0.002 BNB, 2,700 shares total, open to anyone, no per-wallet cap
- Views: freeSold(), paidSold(), freeClaimed(address), PRICE, START, END, SHARE, FREE_CAP, PAID_CAP
- Transfers are unrestricted from the start; there is no pool and no trading tax
- After the window ends, anyone may call finalize() to burn the unsold reserve left in the contract
